item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rad+na gling pa'am 'chi med 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsal lam ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi mas dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug gi chu srin gre ba nas rgyas bkrol te/ slar bka' rgya grol mtshams spa ston g.yung drung bstan pa'i 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po sogs las can bla grwa du ma nas bskul ba dang / nye bar rgyal sras pad+ma phrin las sras yum bcas nas bka' yis bskul bzhin chu bya sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs gsang 'dus dus chen gyi skabs su shog ser las zhal bshus shing drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan nas bris shing yi ge dang po'i byed po tshul grags nas bgyis pa'i dge des 'gro rnams smin grol rgya ru gyur cig/
